title: Paeoniae decoction attenuates chronic colitis-associated intestinal fibrosis by suppressing TGF-beta/Smad-mediated epithelial-mesenchymal transition and remodeling the metabolic microenvironment.
authors: Zhao, Meng; Yi, Qi; Liang, Jieyin; Li, Chunjing; Ke, Xuezhou; Zhao, Yijia; Shi, Yuan; Deng, Siliang; Wang, Qing; Luo, Xia; Zhou, Lian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂对肠纤维化的作用机制，涉及TGF-beta/Smad通路和代谢组学，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Paeoniae Decoction (PD) is a classic Chinese medicine formula for treating intestinal diseases. However, its direct intervention effect on intestinal fibrosis and the underlying molecular mechanisms have not been fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the effect of PD on inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) associated intestinal fibrosis and to systematically investigate its potential molecular mechanisms utilizing integrated multi-omics. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical constituents of PD were characterized and quantified utilizing ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometry (LC-Q-Orbitrap-MS) and LC-MS/MS. A chronic experimental colitis-associated intestinal fibrosis mouse model lasting 56 days and involving four repeated cycles of dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) injury was established. The therapeutic efficacy of PD was evaluated through endoscopy, histopathological analysis, and collagen staining. Label-free quantitative proteomics and untargeted metabolomics and network pharmacology were employed to elucidate the target networks. In vitro mechanisms were further validated in TGF-beta1-stimulated NCM460 cells using wound healing assays, immunofluorescence, and Western blotting to evaluate the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) process and the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway. Finally, molecular docking was used to verify the direct binding of the main bioactive components of PD to the key pathway targets. RESULTS: Chemical profiling identified 16 common constituents across independent batches of PD. In vivo, PD administration significantly ameliorated intestinal fibrosis and reduced massive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition in the mucosal and submucosal layers. Integrated omics analyses revealed that PD profoundly modulated the TGF-beta signaling pathway, ECM-receptor interaction, and the Sphingolipid signaling pathway. Mechanistically, PD dose-dependently inhibited myofibroblast activation, downregulating the expression of alpha-SMA, Vimentin, Collagen I, and Collagen III. In vitro, PD serum suppressed TGF-beta1-induced cell migration, preserved the epithelial marker E-cadherin, and inhibited the nuclear translocation of Snail by significantly decreasing the phosphorylation of Smad2 and Smad3. Furthermore, PD reversed pro-fibrotic sphingolipid metabolism and upregulated taurine and glutathione metabolism associated with antioxidant defense. CONCLUSION: PD effectively alleviates chronic colitis-associated intestinal fibrosis by inhibiting the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway-mediated EMT process, reducing ECM deposition, and reprogramming the fibrotic metabolic microenvironment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：芍药汤（PD）是一种治疗肠道疾病的经典中药方剂。然而，其对肠道纤维化的直接干预作用及潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：评估芍药汤对炎症性肠病（IBD）相关肠道纤维化的作用，并利用整合多组学方法系统研究其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆-Orbitrap质谱（LC-Q-Orbitrap-MS）和LC-MS/MS对芍药汤的化学成分进行表征和定量。建立持续56天、涉及四次葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）损伤循环的慢性实验性结肠炎相关肠道纤维化小鼠模型。通过内镜检查、组织病理学分析和胶原染色评估芍药汤的治疗效果。采用无标记定量蛋白质组学、非靶向代谢组学和网络药理学阐明靶点网络。在TGF-β1刺激的NCM460细胞中，利用伤口愈合实验、免疫荧光和Western blotting进一步验证体外机制，以评估上皮-间质转化（EMT）过程和TGF-β/Smad信号通路。最后，使用分子对接验证芍药汤主要生物活性成分与关键通路靶点的直接结合。结果：化学分析在独立批次的芍药汤中鉴定出16种共有成分。在体内，芍药汤给药显著改善肠道纤维化，并减少黏膜和黏膜下层中大量细胞外基质（ECM）沉积。整合组学分析揭示，芍药汤深刻调节TGF-β信号通路、ECM-受体相互作用和鞘脂信号通路。机制上，芍药汤剂量依赖性地抑制肌成纤维细胞活化，下调α-SMA、Vimentin、Collagen I和Collagen III的表达。在体外，芍药汤血清抑制TGF-β1诱导的细胞迁移，保留上皮标志物E-cadherin，并通过显著降低Smad2和Smad3的磷酸化抑制Snail的核转位。此外，芍药汤逆转促纤维化鞘脂代谢，并上调与抗氧化防御相关的牛磺酸和谷胱甘肽代谢。结论：芍药汤通过抑制TGF-β/Smad信号通路介导的EMT过程、减少ECM沉积和重编程纤维化代谢微环境，有效缓解慢性结肠炎相关肠道纤维化。
